summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze the confidential supply-chain data, build a general recheck-and-act agent product (renamed Lighthouse) with role-based UI for a senior buyer and head of procurement, and prepare interviews, the pitch deck and hand-in by 12:00 Sunday.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition misses launch despite the plan saying all ok (overbooked art books, failed statues, new Sat drops). Built and pushed a polling/versioned pipeline and the product UI: separate Felix/Maren sign-ins, inbox split, History page, 'Fixed today', heartbeat. Merged PR #8 and started a Pulse-style 'Describe it' routines UI on a branch (unpushed). Deck, live restart and document-reading port are still open.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) with no webhooks or notifications. Files get replaced under the same name, so polling must compare SHA-256 checksums.

The app mirrors portal files into data/portal/ and keeps its own state in data/state. The live server (:8000) polls the portal; the demo server (:8001) runs without a portal token on purpose, so the heartbeat must be hidden there.
Live serves the rebuilt web build immediately, but backend changes (sign-in choice, 'Waiting for your OK', who-decided field) need a server restart.
Team workflow requires Entire checks (entire status, entire brain status) before pushing, and PROGRESS.md/CLAUDE.md claim tasks. Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change.
Routines call Claude (claude-opus-5-5) with the key from .env, independent of ASK_LLM_PROVIDER, so they also work on the demo.
Merging PR #8 brought 335 portal data files into main under data/portal, contrary to the challenge rules about confidential data. History keeps them even if removed from the tree.

Lucas's new-approach branch contains a pulse-console app with its own server, inbox and email sending that bypasses the duplicate-send guard and demo record-only mode. Only its 'read documents before verification' step is worth porting.
workflow: Use git worktrees (e.g. ../ask-soony-llm-task-update, ../ask-soony-pulse) to inspect or work on other branches while live and demo servers run from the main folder.
Verify UI changes with headless-browser screenshots against a read-only server on a copy of demo state, never against live.
Check what the UI already shows before adding features; the 'Covered' line was dropped as redundant and replaced with 'Fixed today'.
Don't let the UI imply 'fine' with green; use ✓ and past-tense wording so meaning does not depend on colour.
Ask before pushing to teammates' branches, and rebase on origin before pushing main when new team commits exist.

friction: The user's wording was often ambiguous: roles were replaced instead of added next to names, 'Ask Maren to approve' showed on her own cases, and 'green' was misread as a status light.
The demo showed 'Not checked since 08:30' because it never polls the portal, which looked broken.
The first 'Fixed today' version wrongly listed Boise's 36,000 cards, which arrive too late, because it read supplier reply fields rather than confirmed orders.
PR #8 had a test-file conflict and carried 335 portal data files; the PR was merged by someone else before data/ could be removed.
The previous summary and session state had to be rebuilt after context compaction.
Several of the user's requests were interrupted mid-tool-call and redirected.
ESLint is not configured in the web app, so lint is skipped there.
open_items: Remove data/portal from main (git rm -r --cached data/portal) and decide whether stored readings and golden.json stay in the repo.
Push branch jonas/pulse-ui (1c9c94f, Describe-it chat on Routines) and open a PR; push main with the shortcut-hint fix (baeb33f).
Restart the live server so the new sign-in choice, Maren's 'Waiting for your OK' and the heartbeat appear.
Port 'read new documents before verifying' (recognize_changed / read_with_backend) into runner.run_pipeline, with safeguards for no-model and try/except; tell Lucas.
Make Routines visible for the procurement role as well, to show them if only one role is checked out, and confirm the new UI is on the branch the user views.
Check whether the papercheck module is covered by the screenshot's requirement; the user may delegate it to a colleague.
Build the pitch deck (6 slides, from docs/demo-script.md, with Lio figures, network map and Maren's quote) and record the video before the 12:00 hand-in.
Manually click through the Describe-it chat, the History link and the sign-off page for a passed-on case; none were tested in a browser.
Send the Karton Nowak art-book order and Boise reply for real, once sender addresses are registered; unclear whether our actions change portal data.

Optional: delete the duplicate 'Ask Hamburg to count book stock' routine, fix the demo loop not auto-raising call alerts, and switch the OpenAI webhook back to https://ask-soony.stenglein.dev/hooks/openai after the demo.
